methodology.target: Restore each non-defense occupation to its December 31, 2024 level (last OPM snapshot before January 19, 2025).
methodology.positions: Sum of per-occupation NET declines across non-defense agencies. Growth in one field does not offset losses in another, and offsetting growth is not double-counted.
methodology.cost: Baseline average salary per occupation x positions to restore, loaded x1.33 for benefits and overhead. Base payroll excludes the loading.
methodology.salary_imputation: Redacted salaries (OPM withholds ~46% government-wide, concentrated in defense) are imputed from the baseline average of the same pay-plan+grade, then occupation, then the non-defense mean. Values outside [10k, 500k] are treated as unreported.
methodology.defense: Defense civilians are excluded from the headline; September defense submissions are incomplete (~10,000 records missing).
methodology.caveats: Net headcount change is not a count of layoffs. Some turnover is ordinary attrition. Restoring to the pre-transition level is a policy choice, not an established staffing requirement.
